noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

methods.description:
Key: Field name separated by dots.
Value: Function that should be invoked to make a deep copy of the field specified by the corresponding Key.

title:
Annotation used to enable users to register custom copying behavior when invoking {@link MLPipeBase#deepCopyPipe}.
Note that this annotation does not support handling custom copying behavior for nested fields for a pipe which is
a field upon another pipe. Concretely, this means that
`@DeepCopyHelper(methods={"steps.pipe.foo.bar"=...})`
is not supported.
name: Ann.DeepCopyHelper
